area: Sample playback (sinc/linear, time stretcher) and the DX7 engine, per voice and 128-sample block

measured.case: dx7 alg5 fb6 + LFO amp mod

topFunctions: SampleLowLevelReader::readSamplesResampled (sinc stereo +7: 13,278/block, about 104 per sample in the loop itself)
SampleLowLevelReader::interpolate (7,424 stereo / 5,760 mono: an out-of-line call per sample, 58/45 instr)
SampleLowLevelReader::jumpForwardLinear + interpolateLinear (3,968 + 2,432: out-of-line calls per sample)
EngineMkI::compute / compute_pure / compute_fb3 (about 30 instr per sample and op, switch branches)
neon_fm_kernel (3,945 for 5 ops) + FmOpKernel::compute_fb (3,220, scalar feedback op)

proposals.title: Sinc loop: inline interpolate(), keep oscPos and *amplitude in locals, specialise the loop (template) on numChannels, condensing and writingCache
proposals.estSavingPerBlock: about 3,000-4,500 per sinc voice (15-20%), twice that for a time-stretch crossfade
proposals.risk: low-medium: keep the goto skipFirstSmooth entry and the >16 jump path

proposals.title: Keep the interpolation buffer in NEON registers for the whole block (shift by vext, insert lane 0 per new sample), store it back once
proposals.estSavingPerBlock: about 1,500-2,000 (stereo), because the 8 vstr + 8 vldr per sample go away

proposals.title: Stereo reduction with vpadd and one vmov r,r,d instead of 2x(vadd, 2 vmov, add, str)
proposals.estSavingPerBlock: about 650, plus fewer A9 NEON-to-core stalls (not counted)

proposals.title: Linear loop: inline jumpForwardLinear and interpolateLinear, oscPos/amplitude in locals
MkI engine: branchless sinLog (quadrant by bit masks instead of switch), sign by XOR mask, add/no-add specialised
proposals.where: dsp/dx/EngineMkI.cpp: sinLog, mkiSin, compute, compute_pure, compute_fb*
proposals.estSavingPerBlock: about 5,000-6,000 per MkI voice (20%) plus fewer mispredicts

proposals.title: Allow n=128 in neon_fm_kernel (today simd_n=132 because n%12==8 is refused); trim the compute_fb stack reloads

notes: What the bench runs is the firmware code itself. run.sh cuts bufferIndividualSampleForInterpolation through readSamplesNative out of sample_low_level_reader.cpp, plus TimeStretcher::readFromBuffer and getWhichKernel. It compiles dsp/dx completely, and on ARM also neon_fm_kernel.s. Two things are not measured: considerUpcomingWindow/clusters and TimeStretcher::hopEnd. hopEnd runs once per hop and needs Sample and the perc cache. For time stretching I measured two crossfading play heads instead. The readFromBuffer case is dead code in this build (TIME_STRETCH_ENABLE_BUFFER=0). On the PC the build runs without the alignment and signed-overflow checks, because the firmware reads misaligned on purpose and msfa wraps its phase. KEEP=dir keeps the ELF for objdump. MkI is chosen with engine mode MkI, or in auto mode for algorithms 4/6 with feedback: 2.3% vs 0.75% per voice.
